title: fix(ui): a dialog's focus trap no longer pulls Tab back when a tooltip closes on blur
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Sy653R4fA2ArwDP1QvFqq9)_

Fixes #33980

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim by `domain:ui#1`, card-thread session `session_01ADHkmPwoJquHrWGDjT1P4r`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给弹窗焦点陷阱（Radix `FocusScope`）的补丁加一段：只有「上一个获得焦点的元素」真的不在弹窗里了，才把焦点拉回弹窗本身。导入向导里 #33960 加的局部绕法（把 tooltip 挪出弹窗）随之撤掉。
- 为什么改：弹窗里一个带内联 tooltip 的按钮，按 Tab 离开时 tooltip 被卸载，陷阱误判为「焦点元素被删」，把焦点拉回弹窗，键盘用户出不去。除导入向导外，实测「管理视图」对话框也中招：Tab 过不了第一行的 Pin 按钮，其余视图、Done、Close 都到不了。修在陷阱上，所有弹窗一次修好。
- 风险与回滚：只改补丁里一个判断条件，焦点元素真被删除时仍拉回弹窗（单测对照钉住）。改动面是所有 Dialog / Sheet / AlertDialog 的焦点处理；回滚即 revert（会同时带回导入向导的问题，因为局部绕法已撤）。
- 先看：`patches/@radix-ui__react-focus-scope.patch`（新增的 handleMutations 两行），`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-popover-focus-scope.test.tsx`（新 describe），`ui/e2e/manage-views-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test e2e/manage-views-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts e2e/import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts --project=chromium`，预期 6 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`patches/@radix-ui__react-focus-scope.patch`** (the file `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s `patchedDependencies` applies) gains a second hunk in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`: the trapped scope's `MutationObserver` callback returns early when the last focused element is still inside the container. Stock radix focuses the container whenever a node under it is removed while focus sits on `body`; between the blur and the focus of a native Tab focus does sit on `body`, so a node that a blur unmounts (an inline tooltip closing under its trigger) pulled focus back to the container. The callback now acts only on the case it exists for: the focused element, or an ancestor of it, was itself removed. The earlier stack-race hunk is unchanged.
- **`ui/patches/@radix-ui__react-focus-scope.patch`** gets the same bytes. It is an unreferenced copy (nothing reads it; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` names the root file), kept identical rather than left to drift; deleting it is not this card. **`ui/patches/README.md`**: the entry now describes both halves, its Tracking/Upstream rows name the second, and Remove-when requires every regression case green with the patch removed.
- **`pnpm-lock.yaml`**: the patch hash for `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope@1.1.16` (7 lines, from `pnpm install`).
- **`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`**: #33960's local `createPortal` of the Save-current reason tooltip is removed (`git apply -R` of that hunk); the tooltip mounts inline again, and Tab still leaves it (spec below).
- **Changesets**: new `.changeset/33980-focus-trap-blur-unmount.md` (`@object-ui/console`, `@objectstack/console`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: patch). **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** of the pending `.changeset/33862-import-wizard-save-reason-tab-trap.md`: its last sentence said "The tooltip now renders outside the dialog, so Tab and Shift+Tab walk every control in order…", which this PR makes false; it now reads "The dialog's focus trap no longer reads that removal as focus lost, so Tab and Shift+Tab walk every control in order and the reason is still read out when the wrapper is focused." `check-empty-changeset` is red on that file by design.

### Why A (the focus-scope patch) and not B (portal `TooltipContent`)

Measured first, on `origin/main` `fb79d47c`: which inline-tooltip triggers sit inside a modal dialog. Statically, 35 non-test files under `ui/packages` name `TooltipContent`; six of them also render a Dialog / Sheet / AlertDialog (ImportWizard, ManageViewsDialog, MarketplacePackagePage, MarketplaceRowActions, StudioDesignSurface, the Shadcn sidebar). Measured in Chromium with real Tab presses (Vite bundle from `src/`, no stylesheet):

| Site | Before (fb79d47c) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Import wizard, Save-current reason (with #33960's portal removed) | trapped (the #33960 spec's ablation leg, and below) | all 8 stops |
| Manage Views dialog, each row's Pin / Set-as-default button (`ObjectView` wires both) | trapped: search, drag, `All`, Pin, **dialog**, search… | all 12 stops |
| A generic Dialog with a focusable tooltip trigger between two buttons | trapped: a, b, **dialog**, a… | a, b, c, Close |

Not measured: `StudioDesignSurface` (a tooltip in an inspector its selection Sheet may hold), tooltips in views a record drawer may host, and `DisabledReasonTrigger` when metadata places a disabled action inside a modal. A covers them whatever they turn out to be.

Why "no stylesheet" is the production case: the Console's `index.css` leaves `@plugin 'tailwindcss-animate'` commented out, so `data-[state=closed]:animate-out` has no rule and a closing tooltip unmounts at once, inside the blur→focus gap. With an exit animation the unmount waits for `animationend` and nothing traps (measured on the generic probe: a, b, c, Close) — which is why this hides in some setups.

- **A** fixes the trap's heuristic, so every blur-driven unmount under a modal is covered, not only tooltips, in every dialog at once; the repo already patches this exact package and version for another focus race, with a README entry and a removal condition.
- **B was not taken**: it closes only the tooltip half (any other node a blur removes still traps); `ui/packages/components/src/ui/tooltip.tsx` is a Shadcn-synced file (ui/AGENTS.md #7), tracked from shadcn's `default` style, which does not portal, so B is a local divergence to declare in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`; and it moves every tooltip in the app out of its subtree into `body`, a DOM change for every tooltip to fix a defect that only exists under a focus trap.

## Tests

- **Unit, `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/dialog-popover-focus-scope.test.tsx`** (the shared harness of the existing patch; new top-level `describe`): a trapped scope whose trigger drops a sibling node on blur — after `blur()` focus is not on the container (red on stock); CONTROL — removing the focused element itself still focuses the container (green either way). A scripted `blur()` puts focus on `body` before the observer callback runs, so this unit case can go red in happy-dom, unlike a `user-event` Tab walk.
- **New e2e, `ui/e2e/manage-views-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts`** (Build & E2E UI, chromium; the harness of #33960's spec): the real `ManageViewsDialog` bundled from source, native Tab and Shift+Tab over two editable views (12 stops, past both Pins and Set-as-default) and a CONTROL of two read-only views (no tooltip trigger, 7 stops).
- **`ui/e2e/import-wizard-keyboard-tab-order.spec.ts`**: green with the local portal removed. Forced test edit: its header sentence "The reason tooltip is now portalled out of the dialog…" became false and now names the trap patch; no assertion changed.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first): the patch's guard line deleted from the installed `dist/index.mjs` (marker `/* ablated */`, guard count 1 → 0, blob `4dfa11db5c8c` → `a97219dd468f`).
  - unit: the new case red, the control and the 3 existing cases green;
  - e2e: Manage Views editable case red (`…, manage-views-pin-all, dialog, manage-views-search, …`), import wizard nothing-mapped and tooltip cases red (`…, reason:import-template-save-btn, dialog, …`), the 3 controls green.
  - Restore proven both times: blob back to `4dfa11db5c8c`, which is the post-image blob the patch itself names for `dist/index.mjs`; guard count 1. (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` refused to certify the restore of a path git does not track, so the restore was done by hand and proven by hash.)

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/patches/README.md`'s header still says patches are "declared in the root `package.json`"; they are declared in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`. Doc drift, outside this card's file surface; noted, not fixed.
- No upstream radix issue is known for the mutation-handler half; the README says so rather than citing one.

## Verification

Local, on head `279bded8` (merge base `fb79d47c`; `origin/main` `63db7240`, none of its 10 commits touches these files): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 52; `--ran` with the exit codes: 52 derived, 51 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exits 1 **by design**: the DELIBERATE CORRECTION of `.changeset/33862-import-wizard-save-reason-tab-trap.md` above, for the seat's record.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist/`, and only the closures these tests need were built). It is derived from the lockfile line only; CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it on a full build.
- Also run: `ui` `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 0 of 10 paths, 477 changed lines.
